# websearch

Proposed provider-independent web search, fetch and crawl values; no runtime or persistent provider owner.

`connectors.websearch` is one of connectors's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `ContentForm`

`connectors.websearch.ContentForm` is one of `none`, `snippet` and `full`.

### `CrawlInput`

`connectors.websearch.CrawlInput` is a record of eight fields:

- `url` — `String`
- `limit` — `Integer`
- `max_depth` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `max_breadth` — `Optional<Integer>`, which may be absent
- `select_paths` — `Optional<List<String>>`, which may be absent
- `exclude_paths` — `Optional<List<String>>`, which may be absent
- `allow_external` — `Optional<Boolean>`, which may be absent
- `instructions` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

### `Failure`

`connectors.websearch.Failure` is a record of two fields:

- `url` — `String`
- `reason` — `connectors.websearch.FailureReason`

### `FailureReason`

`connectors.websearch.FailureReason` is one of `unreachable`, `blocked`, `not_text`, `too_large` and `provider_refused`.

### `FetchInput`

`connectors.websearch.FetchInput` is a record of one field:

- `urls` — `List<String>`

### `Page`

`connectors.websearch.Page` is a record of four fields:

- `url` — `String`
- `title` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `content` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `content_truncated` — `Boolean`

### `PagesAnswer`

`connectors.websearch.PagesAnswer` is a record of five fields:

- `pages` — `List<connectors.websearch.Page>`
- `failed` — `List<connectors.websearch.Failure>`
- `complete` — `Boolean`
- `truncation` — `List<connectors.websearch.TruncationCause>`
- `provenance` — `connectors.websearch.Provenance`

### `Provenance`

`connectors.websearch.Provenance` is a record of three fields:

- `instance` — `String`
- `profile` — `String`
- `received_at` — `Timestamp`

### `SearchAnswer`

`connectors.websearch.SearchAnswer` is a record of four fields:

- `results` — `List<connectors.websearch.SearchResult>`
- `complete` — `Boolean`
- `truncation` — `List<connectors.websearch.TruncationCause>`
- `provenance` — `connectors.websearch.Provenance`

### `SearchInput`

`connectors.websearch.SearchInput` is a record of nine fields:

- `query` — `String`
- `max_results` — `Integer`
- `content` — `Optional<connectors.websearch.ContentForm>`, which may be absent
- `time_range` — `Optional<connectors.websearch.TimeRange>`, which may be absent
- `topic` — `Optional<connectors.websearch.Topic>`, which may be absent
- `include_domains` — `Optional<List<String>>`, which may be absent
- `exclude_domains` — `Optional<List<String>>`, which may be absent
- `country` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `language` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

### `SearchResult`

`connectors.websearch.SearchResult` is a record of seven fields:

- `url` — `String`
- `title` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `description` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `content` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `content_truncated` — `Boolean`
- `published` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `score` — `Optional<Decimal>`, which may be absent

### `TimeRange`

`connectors.websearch.TimeRange` is one of `day`, `week`, `month` and `year`.

### `Topic`

`connectors.websearch.Topic` is one of `general` and `news`.

### `TruncationCause`

`connectors.websearch.TruncationCause` is one of `provider_limit`, `provider_partial`, `result_limit`, `response_bytes` and `content_bytes`.

Five of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors.websearch.CrawlInput`, `connectors.websearch.FetchInput`, `connectors.websearch.PagesAnswer`, `connectors.websearch.SearchAnswer` and `connectors.websearch.SearchInput`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names them, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
